> 📄 **Authoritative instructions:** [`SETUP.md`](https://github.com/FifeCIC/Trading-Command-Suite/blob/master/SETUP.md).
> This page summarises the choice; it does not replace them.

This is a **source install**, not an application package. There is no installer yet — packaging is
tracked in [#1147](https://github.com/FifeCIC/Trading-Command-Suite/issues/1147).

## Two tracks — decide first

| | **Track A — web + API** | **Track B — full stack** |
|---|---|---|
| Adds | MySQL, Node.js | + Windows, MetaTrader 5, a broker account |
| Time | ~10 minutes | considerably longer |
| You get | every page, the database, scoring, the Lab, backtesting, charts | all of that **plus** live prices, positions, order placement |
| You do not get | broker bridging, positions, order placement | — |

**MetaTrader 5 is not required to run the app** — only to trade through it, and to see state that only
a broker holds. A Track A install is a working application, not a broken one.

## The short version

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FifeCIC/Trading-Command-Suite.git
cd trading-command-suite
npm install
cd nest && npm install && cd ..
cp nest/.env.example nest/.env     # then set DATABASE_URL
```

Create the MySQL schema from `nest/prisma/`, then:

```powershell
npm --prefix nest run start:dev    # API on :3201
npm run dev                        # frontend on :5173
```

Verify with `curl http://localhost:3201/api/health` — you want `status: ok` and
`database: connected`. `"mode": "fallback"` is **normal** (no Redis), not a fault.

## The one thing that will destroy your data

**Never run `prisma db push`.** `schema.prisma` is not the complete schema: several tables are managed
outside Prisma — the trade execution queue among them — so `db push` drops them with the data still
inside. It does not error; it warns and waits for a `y`.

```powershell
npm --prefix nest run db:check     # read-only; names any table the schema does not know
```

## Before you connect an account

Read the [Financial Disclaimer](Financial-Disclaimer). The software is **not configured to profit by
default**, and a demo account is the only sensible place to start.

Stuck at any point? [Troubleshooting](Troubleshooting) lists the traps with the misleading message each
one produces.
